objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed document created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, translated, and evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of a document; the assignment of the consecutive number can be adapted.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned as part of the document abbreviation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and used in workflows and reports.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted after release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from valid from and the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute mentioned together with releaser for authorizations.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects email notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects distribution of acknowledgement workflow tasks when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type used for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for few departments.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a new document; templates and validity periods can be defined for it.

objs.name: document_level
objs.description: Level used to structure documents and document types.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached to create new documents or requests in the system.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File that can be uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: document_property
objs.description: Properties dialog or metadata area where standardized and customer-specific metadata are maintained.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data that documents can be linked with, such as IT applications.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked or filed process-specifically.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example and document property attribute used for linking documents.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained through document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained through document properties.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Attribute used to link documents to master data or other documents.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement a document with additional information; released and published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating in roles, workflows, authorizations, distribution, acknowledgements, and dashboards.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group assigned to roles, reader access, distribution, archive access, or authorizations.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to grant read and change rights.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role or users who can view approved objects and access documents via the reader dashboard.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role or registered user who signs creation of the document in the first workflow step and edits change proposals.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Role or user with personal change rights without relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role or user who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role or user responsible for the document and its content and for distributing it to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role or user who can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: workflow_participant
objs.description: User involved in workflow tasks for release, validity extension, override, or reactivation.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented per released version.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned and completed during workflows; users are informed by email notifications.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to involved users about workflow tasks, change proposals, validity extension, distribution, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing a document without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created by revision, release, or reactivation and used in status and validity handling.

objs.name: release_process
objs.description: Workflow-supported 3-step process consisting of Creator, Review, and Release.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system 30 days before validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request for Override or declaration of Out of force created for a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created in a folder to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons assigned to distribution of a document.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from distribution recipients and documented without a signature.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard filled from distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, workflows, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document that must be checked and released.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content using an implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current version or PDF of a document on the web or in dashboards.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change a released document, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorizations through a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign an author to a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign a co-author to a document.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign a reviewer to a document.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign a releaser to a document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify additional information without creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Start the workflow-supported 3-step release process by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete approval so the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: notify_user
evts.description: Inform involved users of status, workflow tasks, change proposals, validity extension, distribution, or acknowledgement by email.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete workflow tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, creating a new editing version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid-until date.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update the valid-until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension process when a revised new version is released or when suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: Process the request for AKS with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document out of force, archive it, revoke rights except archive group, and retain the request for documentation.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for a request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new version and restoring metadata, properties, authorizations, distribution list, and archived equipment.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate an invalidated document.

evts.name: release_reactivated_document
evts.description: Release the reactivated document according to the defined release process.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons assigned to distribution in the document cockpit.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request persons and users of assigned User Groups by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate or search documents, instructions, workflows, or acknowledgements using reports and dashboards.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version so the document is visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to make a local addition and reference the original document.

o2o.description: A document has a corresponding document type selected during creation.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Document types correspond to document levels in the example breakdown.
Policy is described as a document type.
Guideline is described as a document type.
Procedural Instruction is described as a document type.
Work Instruction is described as a document type.
Properties of a document contain maintainable metadata and authorizations.
Attributes and metadata are grouped into categories.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with processes and filed process-specifically.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with master data.
IT applications are given as an example of master data.
IT applications can be maintained in document properties to link documents.
Relevant companies can be maintained via document properties.
Areas of validity can be maintained via document properties.
References are maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.
Documents can be linked to other documents and local additions can reference original documents.
A document can be supplemented with additional information.
A document can have attachments; attachments are associated with the main document.
Users can be assigned to a document as readers, authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers, or distribution recipients.
User groups can be assigned to documents for reader access, distribution, and authorizations.
Authorization groups are assigned specifically to documents.
Readers may view approved documents and dependent objects.
Each document has a registered author in the Author field.
Co-authors can be assigned via the Co-authors attribute.
Reviewers are maintained in document attributes.
Releasers are maintained in document attributes.
Translation participants are assigned in the document properties dialog.
Users assigned to role user groups are offered in the corresponding selection lists.
The Reader - Document Management user group is implemented for readers.
Users assigned to Authors user groups are offered in author or co-author selection lists.
Users assigned to Reviewer user groups are offered in reviewer selection lists.
Users assigned to the releaser user group are offered in the releaser selection list.
Workflow participants are maintained or assigned for document workflows.
Workflow participants receive and complete workflow tasks.
Workflow participants complete tasks with electronic signatures.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version.
Documents managed in versions have released, editing, archived, or invalidated versions.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
A document has a distribution list maintained in the cockpit.
Persons can be assigned to the distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Acknowledgements are documented for document versions distributed for acknowledgement.
Documents are assigned in dashboards for users included in distribution groups.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
Released documents can have translated language versions.
In a multi-client system, document visibility can be specified per client.
Users in the Archive group still have read access to archived documents.
Only the Business Admin group is permitted to create requests for reactivation.
